answer: A Crystal Mooring Bond stops cheap clones at the jetty. First, a new agent locks 2,000 POA for 90 days and registers one hardware-backed key, so one device cannot mint fifty faces. Second, three established agents inspect its past work and co-sign, losing 200 POA each if it later cheats. Third, its record is published like a sonnet: short, signed, and impossible to quietly rewrite, so duplicates are spotted instantly. Faking 1,000 identities would cost 2,000,000 POA plus 3,000 vouches, while one honest agent pays once. It is a harbour pass, not a password: easy to show, ruinous to forge.
